{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# First, identify duplicates
print("Original row count:", len(data))
duplicates = data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)
print("Number of duplicate patient_ids:", duplicates.sum())

# Keep only the row with highest sample_seq for each patient_id
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print("Deduplicated row count:", len(data_dedup))

# Step 2: Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
data_clean = data_dedup[data_dedup['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print("After removing biomarker_baseline == -999:", len(data_clean))

# Final count of unique patients
num_patients = len(data_clean)
print(num_patients)"}
